title: Matching families give the fpqc compatibility equation
statement:
Let X be a scheme and F an etale sheaf of sets. Let P be a presheaf of sets on X_proet with equivalences e_Y:P(Y) ≃ Gamma(Y_et,Y.hom^*F), intertwining restriction with the inverse-image unit followed by terminal composition transport. For any family g_i:Z_i→Y in X_proet and any matching family s_i in P(Z_i), define t_i in Gamma((Z_i)_et,g_i^*(Y.hom^*F)) by applying terminal transport to e_i(s_i) and restricting along the canonical lift of the terminal object. Then these t_i satisfy the exact overlap compatibility equation of fpqc descent: the pullbacks along the two scheme fibre-product projections agree after the unit-compatible composition isomorphisms and pullback.condition transport. No covering or nonemptiness assumption is needed. The sites, sheaves, inverse images and terminal transports are those in the statement dependencies.
Conventions: small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]; small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]; sheaves of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]; inverse images, their units and composition isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units]; terminal section transport [def-weil-pbc-sets-terminal-transport].

proof.text: Define the canonical terminal pullback lift and identify it with the inverse of the second-projection isomorphism. Normalize terminal transport by cancelling the two presheaf restriction maps. This gives tr, equality transport followed by the inverse composition isomorphism at the terminal object, and rewrites the assumed restriction formula as res followed by tr.inv. Define t_i = tr(Y.hom,g_i,Z_i.hom).hom(e_i(s_i)); the normalization proves precisely the required displayed formula for t_i.

Prove coefficient naturality of terminal restriction res from naturality of the inverse-image unit in a sheaf morphism and presheaf naturality of the pulled-back morphism along the terminal lift. For a commuting triangle, substitute the structure-map equalities and evaluate the associativity clause of the chosen inverse-image composition isomorphisms at the terminal object. Precompose with the first composition isomorphism, apply coefficient naturality and associativity, and cancel the final isomorphism. This proves transport_triangle, relating restriction of the normalized t_i to normalized transport of the corresponding restricted section.

Each underlying g_i is weakly etale by cancellation against Y.hom. Thus the scheme fibre product of g_i and g_j, with structure map fst followed by Z_i.hom, defines an object W of X.ProEt. Its two projections a and d satisfy a composed with g_i = d composed with g_j by pullback.condition. Evaluate transport_triangle on e_i(s_i) and e_j(s_j), use hres to identify their restricted sections with e_W(P.map(a.op)(s_i)) and e_W(P.map(d.op)(s_j)), and apply the matching equality hs. Equality elimination in the map to Y identifies the two normalized transports with exactly Eq.mp along pullback.condition.symm. This proves the overlap equality. No covering or nonemptiness hypothesis is used.

    (P : X.ProEtᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1))
    (e : ∀ Y : X.ProEt, P.obj (op Y) ≃
      ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F).obj.obj
        (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y.left))))
    (hres : ∀ (Y Z : X.ProEt) (g : Z ⟶ Y) (s : P.obj (op Y)),
      e Z (P.map g.op s) =
        (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
          (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ g.left) (Type (u + 1))
          (Y.left.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
          (Z.left.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app
            ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F)).hom.app
              (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y.left))) ≫
          (etaleSetTerminalTransport Y.hom g.left Z.hom g.w F).inv) (e Y s))
    {I : Type v} (Y : X.ProEt) (Z : I → X.ProEt) (g : ∀ i, Z i ⟶ Y)
    (s : ∀ i, P.obj (op (Z i))) (hs : Presieve.Arrows.Compatible P g s) :
    ∃ t : ∀ i, ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (g i).left).obj
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F)).obj.obj
          (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (Z i).left))),
      (∀ i, t i =
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (g i).left).obj
          ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F)).obj.map
          (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk
            (pullback.lift (g i).left (𝟙 (Z i).left)
              ((Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm)) (by simp) :
            Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (Z i).left) ⟶
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (g i).left).obj
                (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 Y.left))).op
          ((etaleSetTerminalTransport Y.hom (g i).left (Z i).hom
            (MorphismProperty.Over.w (g i)) F).hom (e (Z i) (s i)))) ∧
      (∀ i j,
      ((Classical.choose etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits.2.2
          Y.left ((Z i).left) (pullback ((g i).left) ((g j).left)) ((g i).left) (pullback.fst ((g
            i).left) ((g j).left))).hom.app ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F)).hom.app
        (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (pullback ((g i).left) ((g j).left)))))
        (((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (pullback.fst ((g i).left) ((g j).left))).obj
            ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback ((g i).left)).obj ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj
              F))).obj.map
          (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk
            (pullback.lift (pullback.fst ((g i).left) ((g j).left)) (𝟙 (pullback ((g i).left) ((g
              j).left)))
              ((Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm))
            (by simp) :
            Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (pullback ((g i).left) ((g j).left))) ⟶
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (pullback.fst ((g i).left) ((g j).left))).obj
                (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 ((Z i).left)))).op
          (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (pullback.fst ((g i).left) ((g j).left))) _
            (((Z i).left).smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            ((pullback ((g i).left) ((g j).left)).smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app
              ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback ((g i).left)).obj ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj
                F))).hom.app
            (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 ((Z i).left)))) (t i))) =
        Eq.mp (congrArg (fun k : pullback ((g i).left) ((g j).left) ⟶ Y.left ↦
          ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F)).obj.obj
            (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (pullback ((g i).left) ((g j).left))))))
          (pullback.condition (f := (g i).left) (g := (g j).left)).symm)
        (((Classical.choose etaleSetInverseImageCompositionUnits.2.2
            Y.left ((Z j).left) (pullback ((g i).left) ((g j).left)) ((g j).left) (pullback.snd
              ((g i).left) ((g j).left))).hom.app ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj F)).hom.app
          (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (pullback ((g i).left) ((g j).left)))))
          (((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (pullback.snd ((g i).left) ((g j).left))).obj
              ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback ((g j).left)).obj ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj
                F))).obj.map
            (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk
              (pullback.lift (pullback.snd ((g i).left) ((g j).left)) (𝟙 (pullback ((g i).left)
                ((g j).left)))
                ((Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm))

                (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (pullback.snd ((g i).left) ((g
                  j).left))).obj

            (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
              (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (pullback.snd ((g i).left) ((g j).left))) _
              (((Z j).left).smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
              ((pullback ((g i).left) ((g j).left)).smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app
                ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback ((g j).left)).obj ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback Y.hom).obj
                  F))).hom.app
